d: iOS to PS Vita port of Rayman 2 The Great Escape
ld: Rayman 2 The Great Escape · PS Vita Port
req:
- No game files are included: the music must be converted from your own copy with tools/stage_data.sh (see below).
- Copy that folder to ux0:data/rayman2thegreatescape/:
- libshacccg.suprx (https://github.com/Rinnegatamante/ShaRKBR33D/releases/latest) in ur0:data/ (extract it with ShaRKBR33D).
- Game files: open the decrypted .ipa as a ZIP and extract Payload/Rayman2.app/.
- Copy to the Vita (ux0:data/rayman2thegreatescape/):
- > Game files are never distributed. You always need your own legally obtained copy of the game.
